scope: MissiveBoardListing wire model and request/notify messages
client/server service routing and authority election
removal of the previous Missives sharing protocol and ESP package
checks: A listing contains only its ID, physical board ID, quest form ID, and posting book form ID.
The ledger key is physical board plus quest; separate physical boards can host independent rows for the same quest.
Claims are serialized under one mutex and one claimant wins per physical-board row.
Claim notifications remove the row for all viewers of that board and grant task activation only to the winner.
Task progress, objective aliases, reward data, and task item contents are absent from the protocol and ledger.
Missives quest stages and personal quest items are filtered from normal STR synchronization.
findings_fixed: Removed an earlier cross-board reservation concept so claiming the same quest on one board does not suppress a listing on another board.
Expired available rows may be retired by the currently elected authority; claimed rows may be retired by their claimant.
Retired and rejected local rows are erased so the board can recover and generate replacement public notices.
